mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(source_center_code, source_center_name) AS centerId, COALESCE(source_center_name, source_center_code) AS centerName, SUM(amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(*) AS allocationCount FROM cost_allocation WHERE deleted = 0 AND fiscal_year = #{year} AND fiscal_period = #{period} GROUP BY COALESCE(source_center_code, source_center_name), COALESCE(source_center_name, source_center_code) ORDER BY centerId
